CREATE VIEW [STAR].[DIM_Customers] AS
SELECT
	T1.[SATZ_ID],
	T1.[DAT_VON_HIST],
	T1.[DAT_BIS_HIST],
	T1.[CompanyName],
	T1.[ContactName],
	T1.[ContactTitle],
	T1.[Address],
	T1.[City],
	T1.[Region],
	T1.[PostalCode],
	T1.[Country],
	T1.[Phone],
	T1.[Fax],
	T1.[CustomerID]
FROM
	[DWH].[DIM_Customers] T1
